observations: Fox Sports reports, based on direct comments from teammate Daniel Atkinson, that Trindall is playing through a severe SC joint injury.
Atkinson said Trindall remained very sore and that trainers had thought pre-match RLPA physical testing could rule him out before the Finals Week 1 match; Trindall nevertheless played that match.
Atkinson expects Trindall to continue playing through the finals. This is an availability signal, not official Week 2 selection or medical clearance.
